thread:
maya: FYI — customer ACME says per-model throughput panels in Console went flat at ~05:10 UTC. They did a metrics key rename overnight and now graphs are zeros. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/abc123 

tom: Can you paste the exact metric samples they saw? @liam can you pull a raw series from our metrics proxy for that org? 

maya: Copying what they sent: 
```
# old metric
redwood_model_request_total{model="gpt-4x",status="success"}
# new metric after rename
redwood_requests{m="gpt-4x",s="ok"}
```

liam: Ok that explains it — all of our per-model dashboard panels use queries like: 
`sum(rate(redwood_model_request_total[1m])) by (model)` 
with label `model`. The exporter rename to `m` and metric name `redwood_requests` means the query returns no series. 

anjali: Ugh. Customer changed exporter without coordinating. Quick wins: 1) update the panels to OR the new metric name, 2) add a recording rule or a temporary compatibility metric in their prometheus, or 3) add a metrics-ingest transform to map new->old. Which is fastest for them? 

maya: They asked for our recommendation and an ETA. They want a fix ASAP — they use graphs in SRE runbooks. I suggested dashboard patch first so graphs come back in 10-15m. 

liam: I can open a quick PR to add fallback queries to our dashboard JSON: use `sum(rate(redwood_model_request_total[1m])) by (model) or sum(rate(redwood_requests[1m])) by (m)` and then alias `m` to `model` with `label_replace` in the query. Example: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_model_request_total[1m])) by (model)
or
sum(label_replace(rate(redwood_requests[1m]), "model", "$1", "m", "(.*)")) by (model)
```

tom: Nice. Also need to update any alerting rules that rely on the old series. @anjali can you run the dashboard PR in staging and smoke the primary customer org panels? 

anjali: On it. I'll deploy to staging and hit the same org id. Expected time: 20m. 

deploy-bot: deploy started — branch=dashboard-fallbacks, env=staging, author=liam, ci_status=passed 

anjali: Staging looks good. Graphs show both series and behave correctly. Running a few synthetic loads to validate rates. 

maya: Customer updated — they applied a temporary recording rule on their side as well, graphs recovered partially. They still want our dashboard change so they don't have to maintain it. 

liam: I'll land the dashboard change to prod after a quick audit for other panels that reference `redwood_model_request_total`. Also adding a short note in the playbook about metric renames and backwards compatibility. 

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded — branch=dashboard-fallbacks, env=prod, duration=3m12s 

anjali: Verified in prod for ACME org. Panels returned to expected throughput values. Running one final sweep for alerts. 

maya: Sent customer update with root cause: exporter renamed metric + labels. Suggested permanent fixes: keep compatibility metrics in exporter or use metrics-ingest aliasing. They appreciated quick turnaround. 

tom: Follow-ups: 1) add automated check that dashboards return non-empty series after metrics schema changes (detect via smoke queries), 2) add docs for recommended exporter deprecation path. I'll add both to the backlog and tag as P1 for console dashboards. 

liam: Created PRs and one-liner playbook. Assigning owners: @tom for automation, @maya for customer comms. 

maya: Closing the loop. Customer confirmed dashboards stable. Marking this resolved from support side. :white_check_mark:
